columnPool.label: Route: South West Main Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the South West Main Line route
columnPool.hint: The 143-mile trunk route from London Waterloo to Weymouth via Woking, Basingstoke, Southampton and Bournemouth - the backbone of the South Western network.

columnPool.label: Route: Hounslow Loop
columnPool.display: Is part of the Hounslow Loop route
columnPool.hint: The suburban loop off the Waterloo-Reading line via Barnes, rejoining near Feltham - opened in 1850, looping through Hounslow and back to Waterloo.

columnPool.label: Route: Kingston Loop
columnPool.display: Is part of the Kingston Loop route
columnPool.hint: The suburban loop off the South West Main Line via Twickenham, Kingston and Norbiton, rejoining the main line near New Malden.

columnPool.label: Route: Waterloo to Reading Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Waterloo to Reading Line route
columnPool.hint: The suburban route from London Waterloo via Richmond and Staines to Reading, from which the Hounslow Loop and Windsor Line both branch off.

columnPool.label: Route: Windsor Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Windsor Line route
columnPool.hint: The branch from Staines to Windsor & Eton Riverside - part of the historic 'Windsor lines' group alongside the Hounslow Loop, both dating back to the original Richmond Railway.

columnPool.label: Route: New Guildford Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the New Guildford Line route
columnPool.hint: The route from Surbiton via Cobham & Stoke d'Abernon to Guildford - an alternative to the main Waterloo-Guildford route via Woking.

columnPool.label: Route: Solent Link
columnPool.display: Is part of the Solent Link route
columnPool.hint: The route linking Southampton and the Solent coast via Fareham and Portchester to Portsmouth Harbour.

columnPool.label: Route: Alton Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Alton Line route
columnPool.hint: The branch from Woking via Aldershot and Farnham to the market town of Alton in Hampshire.

columnPool.label: Route: Shepperton Branch
columnPool.display: Is part of the Shepperton Branch route
columnPool.hint: The branch from Twickenham via Kingston and Hampton Court territory to its terminus at Shepperton.

columnPool.label: Route: Solent & Wessex
columnPool.display: Is part of the Solent & Wessex route
columnPool.hint: The wider grouping of routes around the Solent and into Wessex, linking Southampton, Eastleigh and the Hampshire coast towards Salisbury and Dorset.

columnPool.label: Route: East Devon Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the East Devon Line route
columnPool.hint: The route from Salisbury via Yeovil Junction, Axminster and Honiton into Exeter - the western extension of the South West Main Line through Dorset and East Devon.

columnPool.label: Route: Island Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Island Line route
columnPool.hint: The short railway on the Isle of Wight linking Ryde Pier Head to Shanklin, connecting at Ryde with Wightlink ferries to Portsmouth Harbour.

columnPool.label: Route: Chessington Branch
columnPool.display: Is part of the Chessington Branch route
columnPool.hint: The branch from Motspur Park via Tolworth to its terminus at Chessington South, serving Chessington World of Adventures.

columnPool.label: Route: Hampton Court Branch
columnPool.display: Is part of the Hampton Court Branch route
columnPool.hint: The short branch from Surbiton via Thames Ditton to its terminus at Hampton Court, next to the historic royal palace.

columnPool.label: Route: Lymington Branch Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Lymington Branch Line route
columnPool.hint: The short branch from Brockenhurst to Lymington Pier, connecting with Wightlink ferries to Yarmouth on the Isle of Wight.
